scope.claim: prospective development-only independent-image replication of the LSP torso ranking opportunity
scope.question: Does a COCO person-pose target create a recoverable nonlinear best-head envelope that materially changes scout-backbone rankings relative to a linear probe?
scope.pretraining_overlap: cannot be excluded; discovery evidence only

prior_evidence.selection_consequence: one independent additional admitted dataset is required before a separately frozen reserved-backbone ranker comparison

dataset.person_selection: within each image and target group, choose the eligible category_id=1, iscrowd=0 annotation with greatest positive bbox area; break exact ties by smallest annotation id
dataset.visibility: every required keypoint must have COCO visibility code 2

target_recipes.torso_axis_sine: y component of the unit vector from hip midpoint to shoulder midpoint in image coordinates
target_recipes.torso_axis_cosine: x component of the same unit torso vector
target_recipes.bilateral_knee_extension_cosine: negative mean of left and right cosines between knee-to-hip and knee-to-ankle vectors; a straight leg approaches +1

cohort.official_split: training rows from train2017 and evaluation rows from val2017
cohort.selection: deterministic SHA-256 order within ten source-split quantile strata; torso sine/cosine share strata defined by torso angle and knee extension uses its own target quantiles
cohort.shortfall_policy: fail closed unless each target group supports 600 unique training images and 500 unique validation images

backbones.weights: exact cached pretrained checkpoint specifications already hash-locked by prior real-image panels

preprocessing.image: official JPEG with each extractor's frozen native preprocessing
preprocessing.pca_fit_scope: training rows only per target, seed, and scout backbone

heads.selection: three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV maximizing R2, followed by official-validation-cohort evaluation

opportunity_definition.envelope: maximum held-out test R2 over the four frozen head families

admission.target_rule: all three base checks and at least one rank-change check must pass
admission.dataset_rule: at least one frozen COCO target passes
admission.combined_rule: COCO passes and the hash-locked prior LSP opportunity remains admitted
